claims.statement: The Federal Reserve deleted the six-per-month savings transfer limit in an April 24, 2020 interim final rule.
Linking savings to checking can cover overdrafts for a transfer fee generally lower than an overdraft fee.
The national average savings rate was 0.38% and interest checking 0.07%.
